name: The Punisher
description:
Frank Castle's war on crime, with you in the way.
The Punisher isn't your enemy, exactly. He is a villain who attacks the minions in your way as much as he attacks you, while Rachel Cole-Alves and the Maggia make the war on crime even messier. Plays best with the Sinister Syndicate. 26 cards, rebuilt in English and Spanish. Pairs with Fear No Evil.

permission.evidence: Granted by the author(s) in the Marvel Champions homebrew channel on Discord; confirmed by the project owner (Quin Carter) on 2026-11-13. The curated repository's record: https://github.com/bluefireF5ran/mc-digital-custom-packs/blob/a0c9f6000293115a9ecd58da347468ec875d52bb/punisher_pk/mod.json
permission.scope: inclusion and translation: the Spanish edition, hand-translated by BluefireF5ran, is covered (owner, 2026-11-13)
permission.note: 2026-11-13 is the date the owner confirmed the grant, not the date of the Discord message. The author accepted all of the curators' changes on 2026-11-13, Rachel Cole-Alves included (curated repository a51e50d, mod.json `open`).
